Progress: the bounded importer code is in place, including Context-only cache access, Config-driven explicit subject identity, access-token-only profile construction, encrypted-store reuse, and schema-backed sanitized command output. I’m not blocked on an Effect design question; I’m running the package typecheck now and will correct any API/type mismatches, add deterministic fixture tests and package docs, then run the requested checks without committing.

Next I’m tightening error mapping so malformed cache data can never be carried in diagnostic causes.

content.text: The focused tests caught a real schema-boundary mistake before persistence: the cache decoder correctly produces a redacted token, while the profile schema expects the raw input form and re-wraps it. I’m fixing that explicit in-memory handoff with `Redacted.value(...)`; it does not widen any output or persistence boundary, and it keeps refresh/ID tokens absent.

Focused verification is now green: 43 package tests, typecheck, and build all pass. I’m adding the package-only operating documentation next, including the one-hour conservative TTL, required explicit identity configuration, and the intentional no-refresh/no-account-ID-import limitations.
